notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution targeting Magda, changing all instances of "Dwarf" to either "Elemental" or "Minion".
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping itself, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Tidewater Minion's ability, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.
